name: jylhis-skills
description: Curated agent-skills marketplace by Jylhis. Default plugin (jylhis-skills-core) ships cross-cutting skills; per-language and per-tool plugins are opt-in.

plugins.name: jylhis-skills-core
plugins.description: Default Jylhis bundle: cross-cutting security review and offline documentation lookup. Ships @reviewer / @explorer / @debugger subagents and the /explore + /lsp-status commands.

plugins.name: jylhis-python
plugins.description: Python 3.12+ — modern style, asyncio, type hints, Ruff, uv, pytest.

plugins.name: jylhis-typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript 5.9+ on Node 22 LTS — type system depth, async, ESLint 9 flat config, pnpm workspaces, Vitest.

plugins.name: jylhis-go
plugins.description: Modern Go — slices/maps/cmp packages, sync.OnceFunc, context.AfterFunc, atomic generics, http.ServeMux methods, iter.Seq.

plugins.name: jylhis-rust
plugins.description: Rust — typed boundaries and newtypes, exhaustive enums, error discipline (n0-error), deterministic testing via injected host context, channel-first concurrency.

plugins.name: jylhis-jvm
plugins.description: JVM build/test — Gradle 8.10+ Kotlin DSL, version catalogs, Maven Central, JUnit 5, kotest, Testcontainers.

plugins.name: jylhis-emacs
plugins.description: Emacs + Emacs Lisp — modern Elisp, major-mode authoring, MELPA/ELPA publishing, ERT, debugging, gptel + MCP.

plugins.name: jylhis-nix
plugins.description: Nix / Nixpkgs / NixOS — flakes, packaging, modules, nix-darwin, home-manager, devenv, dockerTools, nixosTests.

plugins.name: jylhis-filesystems
plugins.description: Low-level filesystems — APFS, Btrfs, ZFS / OpenZFS.

plugins.name: jylhis-gitlab
plugins.description: GitLab CI/CD pipelines and the glab CLI for terminal-based GitLab workflows.

plugins.name: jylhis-terraform
plugins.description: Terraform and HCL umbrella skill: style guide, .tftest.hcl testing, module refactoring, and Terraform Stacks. Ships terraform-ls.

plugins.name: jylhis-azure
plugins.description: Azure cloud skill — adoption framework, well-architected, AKS, deployment patterns.

plugins.name: jylhis-obsidian
plugins.description: Obsidian skill — note-taking, knowledge management, plugin workflows.

plugins.name: jylhis-pkm
plugins.description: Personal knowledge management skills: LLM-maintained markdown wiki, PARA organization method, graphify knowledge graphs.

plugins.name: jylhis-grafana
plugins.description: Grafana skill — observability, dashboards, PromQL, alerts, OnCall.

plugins.name: jylhis-taste
plugins.description: Taste skill — UI/UX design taste, visual hierarchy, design critique.

plugins.name: jylhis-duckdb
plugins.description: DuckDB skills — read any data file, query DuckDB databases, search DuckDB/DuckLake docs, search past session logs, explore S3, work with spatial data.

plugins.name: jylhis-engineering
plugins.description: Engineering workflow skills — code review and technical documentation.

plugins.name: jylhis-product
plugins.description: Product-management skills — competitive briefs, brainstorming, roadmaps, sprint planning.

plugins.name: jylhis-productivity
plugins.description: Workplace productivity skills — two-tier working memory and shared-file task management.

plugins.name: jylhis-small-business
plugins.description: Small-business operations skills — HR job-post drafting and tax-season document organizing.

plugins.name: jylhis-careers
plugins.description: Candidate-side job-search skill: tailor a resume/CV and cover letter to a posting and track applications.
